membership_note: DEVELOPMENT policy for the four launch Challenges (Motor, Cooling, F08, F02), N = 4, listed on 2026-10-19 under the owner's delegation to the Test Lead (KOTH-TAKEOVER-RULE-01 §4). Not the registry's current policy: testnet-winner-v1 stays current and unchanged as history. A crown is taken on a shared bank key by more than the Challenge's measured rebuild noise; a king that fails a mandatory gate on a new evaluation version is dethroned and its share burns until a valid winner exists. Score-pack adoption and mainnet use stay the owner's at launch. self_improvement_factor stays null: a same-miner win keeps the old clock. baselines null: the first-incumbent rule applies.
